A workflow for writing and refining agent/system prompts: capture a contract, inventory external context by path, pick a model-family strategy, generate candidates, and compare them on an eval set, returning a prompt package.

Guidance only shapes the reply (prompt text, eval cases, optimization log); no commands, installs, credentials, or network access. Example prompts in transformed-examples.md explicitly include 'Ask before destructive actions'.
